story_log.title: Texas completes historic 20-point comeback to upset No. 1 Ohio State — Arch Manning rally, Ryan Day collapse, Sarkisian walks off interview
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 1]: Texas scored 21 unanswered to complete 20-point 4th quarter comeback, beat No. 1 Ohio State 24-23 per ground truth/ESPN/SportsCenter. AP No. 1 teams were 197-0 when holding 20-point lead in 4Q since 2004 — until tonight per ESPN/TexasFootball. Ohio State kicker missed FG wide left with 1:23 left, Texas got ball back down 6 per ESPN. Hollywood Smothers go-ahead TD made it 24-23 per ClutchPoints. Largest Texas comeback since 2007 per SportsCenter. Sarkisian blew off postgame interview mid-question — 'THAT'S CALLED TEXAS FIGHT! HOOK 'EM!' per JomboyMedia. Ryan Day's largest blown lead of career per JomboyMedia. Arch Manning nightmares quote post-game per HaterReport. Yesterday: pregame hype, Jeremiah Smith first half dominance, Pat McAfee flyover pick.

story_log.title: Ryan Garcia drops Conor Benn with vicious right hand, finishes him with TKO in second round — takes welterweight title in Las Vegas
story_log.development: Garcia knocked down Benn with vicious right hand, finished him with TKO in second round per HaterReport/CBS Sports. Won WBC welterweight title at T-Mobile Arena per CBS Sports. Garcia's right hand speed 'INSANE' even in slow motion per HaterReport. CBS Sports: 'Garcia has the star power already, but now he may be the one to carry the sport on an annual basis' — big win and bigger callouts.

story_log.title: Elena Rybakina wins third career Grand Slam, defeats Aryna Sabalenka in US Open final — second time she's beaten Sabalenka in Major final this year
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Rybakina defeated Sabalenka in US Open final to win third career Major, her first at US Open per SportsCenter/ESPN. Second time Rybakina has beaten Sabalenka in Major final this year per SportsCenter. Maria Sharapova handed Rybakina trophy per ESPN. New World No. 1 Rybakina caps dominant run. Yesterday: Rybakina and Sabalenka both reached final, Michelle Obama in attendance.

story_log.title: Oklahoma State stuns No. 6 Oregon as 24.5-point underdog — ends longest FBS losing streak in country at 21 games, Drew Mestemaker's improbable rise
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 2]: Oklahoma State beat No. 6 Oregon 39-31 as 24.5-point underdog per ground truth/SportsCenter — ended 21-game losing streak to FBS opponents (longest in country) per SportsCenter/CBS Sports. Mestemaker: 317 pass yds, 109 rush yds, 3 total TD per StatMuse. CBS Sports: Mestemaker threw for 317 yards and totaled three touchdowns, continuing an improbable rise from high school punter to Oklahoma State starting quarterback. Caleb Hawkins 23 CAR, 108 YDS, 1 TD per StatMuse. Oregon rushed for only 90 yards as team per StatMuse. Yesterday: live game updates, Mestemaker hype.

story_log.title: NFL Week 1 kicks off Sunday — RedZone returns, first full slate since February, Schefter and Pelissero transaction blizzard
story_log.development: NFL regular season begins Sunday with full slate per CBS Sports. NFLMemes/JoeyMulinaro: first RedZone Sunday in months. ghetto_gronk: 'Time to let a professional football team that doesn't know I exist and an imaginary team I drafted determine my mental health for the next 4 months.' Schefter transaction blizzard: Joey Porter Jr. unlikely to play Sunday (back injury + uncertain future), Lamar Jackson and Ravens no substantive extension talks, CJ Stroud and Texans tabled extension talks until after season. Ihartitz: 'X▬▬▬.◙.▬▬▬X...just droppin' down to say Jameson Williams no matter what.' PatMcAfeeShow NFL hype tweets. Giants-Cowboys SNF in John Harbaugh's Giants debut per CBS Sports.

story_log.title: Michigan upsets No. 11 Oklahoma 17-10 — first home win as unranked team vs top-15 opponent since 2008, Kyle Whittingham's Big Ten debut
story_log.development: Michigan beat No. 11 Oklahoma 17-10 per ground truth/SportsCenter — first home win as unranked team vs top-15 opponent since 2008 per SportsCenter. Kyle Whittingham got big win in Big Ten debut. PatMcAfeeShow: locker room feeling real good after that one.

story_log.title: Francisco Lindor crushes grand slam as Mets demolish Yankees 12-2 in Bronx — Gerrit Cole struggles continue in Subway Series
story_log.development: Lindor hit grand slam to put Mets up big in Bronx per ground truth/TalkinBaseball. Mets won 12-2 per ground truth. Lindor: 3-5, 2 HR, 5 RBI — 9th straight full season with 20+ HR (excluding 2020) per StatMuse. Cole now has 8.49 ERA in five career Subway Series starts per TalkinBaseball. JomboyMedia: Cole refused to start game before official start time, then allowed leadoff HR.

story_log.title: Brewers score 33 runs in 14 innings vs Reds — Reds have allowed 47 runs in last 23 innings, getting absolutely demolished
story_log.development: Milwaukee scored 33 runs in 14 innings against Cincinnati in series per TalkinBaseball — Reds have allowed 47 runs in their last 23 innings per TalkinBaseball. Brewers beat Reds 13-9 tonight per ground truth. William Contreras 3-run HR made it 8-5 per ClutchPoints. Brice Turang HR made it 4-0 in first per TalkinBaseball. Reds pitching in absolute shambles.

story_log.title: Randal Grichuk walks off Cardinals with White Sox down to final strike — Chicago wins 6-5
story_log.development: Grichuk delivered walk-off hit with White Sox down to final strike per TalkinBaseball — Chicago beat St. Louis 6-5 per ground truth. Rare White Sox win.

story_log.title: Braves demolish Phillies 12-2 — Ronald Acuña Jr. answers, Michael Harris II 3-run HR, Bryce Harper early blast
story_log.development: Atlanta destroyed Philadelphia 12-2 per ground truth. Harper gave Phillies 1-0 lead with first-inning blast per TalkinBaseball. Acuña answered with solo shot to tie it per TalkinBaseball. Harris hit 3-run HR off foul pole per ClutchPoints. Bryson Stott low throw got by Alec Bohm, Braves extended lead per TalkinBaseball. Dominant Braves win.

story_log.title: Rafael Devers this month: 7 HR, 19 RBI, 8 BB — only PCA has more homers since start of May
story_log.development: Devers in September: 7 HR, 19 RBI, 8 BB per StatMuse. Only PCA has more HR than Devers since start of May per StatMuse. Red Sox beat Royals 5-1 per ground truth. Devers on absolute tear.

story_log.title: Mariners demolish Athletics 19-1 — Randy Arozarena homer part of offensive explosion
story_log.development: Seattle destroyed Oakland 19-1 per ground truth. Arozarena hit HR to extend lead to 5-0 per ClutchPoints. Mariners offensive explosion. Lopsided blowout.

story_log.title: USA vs France for FIBA Women's World Cup gold medal in Berlin — Gabby Williams led France with 22-5-5-4, Breanna Stewart led USA with 16-6-4
story_log.development: USA and France meet for gold medal at FIBA World Cup in Berlin per CBS Sports/StatMuse. Williams vs Germany: 22 PTS, 5 REB, 5 AST, 4 STL, 8-12 FG, +17 — France moves on per StatMuse. Stewart led Team USA in scoring vs Spain: 16 PTS, 6 REB, 4-6 FG, 8-11 FT per StatMuse. USA seeks fifth straight gold per CBS Sports.

story_log.title: Kyle Harrison's last three outings: 7.1 IP, 23 H, 17 ER, 6 BB, 7 SO, 6 HR, 20.86 ERA — tonight lasted 0.0 IP, 4 H, 4 ER
story_log.development: Harrison tonight: 0.0 IP, 4 H, 4 ER, 0 BB, 0 SO per TalkinBaseball. Last three outings (two starts): 7.1 IP, 23 H, 17 ER, 6 BB, 7 SO, 6 HR, 20.86 ERA, 3.95 WHIP per TalkinBaseball. Giants pitcher in total freefall. Padres beat Giants 7-6 per ground truth.

story_log.title: Willson Contreras gives up on at-bat after umpire denies pine tar, throws bat back at home plate after strikeout — on rehab assignment with Red Sox Double-A
story_log.development: Contreras gave up on at-bat after umpire didn't let him get more pine tar, threw bat back at home plate as he walked away after striking out per JomboyMedia. On rehab assignment with Red Sox's Double-A Portland Sea Dogs per JomboyMedia. Bizarre tantrum.

lead_story.research_notes: CONTINUING [Day 1]: Texas overcame a 20-point deficit in the 4th quarter to beat #1 Ohio State 24-23 — the first time an AP #1 team has blown a 20-point 4Q lead since the stat was tracked in 2004 (197-0 before tonight). Hollywood Smothers scored the go-ahead TD. Ryan Day's largest blown lead of his career. Sarkisian completely bailed on the postgame interview mid-question: 'THAT'S CALLED TEXAS FIGHT! HOOK 'EM!' Arch post-game: 'I couldn't lose to them again, I had nightmares about that game last year.' Yesterday's story: pregame hype, Jeremiah Smith first-half dominance, Pat McAfee flyover pick. Research: rank this blown lead among Ohio State's worst collapses. How does this compare to Michigan's Hail Mary win over them? What does this do to Ohio State's CFP path now? How rare is a 20-point 4Q comeback at this level? Name the last time a #1 team choked like this. Meme angle: Ryan Day's history of losing big games. GIF angle: the missed FG and the sideline reaction.
